def transform(grid):

 # interior rectangle bounded by green frame

  for c in range(4,11): out[r][c]=4

  # 2s form concentric square shells around marker, alternating on shell radius two
  for r in range(3,10):
   for c in range(4,11):
    if max(abs(r-mr),abs(c-mc))==2: out[r][c]=2
  out[mr][mc]=3
 return out
